name: Noto Maron
source:
Fetish: Dirty talk
Weak spot: Spanking

A gyaru in heat all year round. Because she used to say dirty words in almost all her phrases, would pick up guys at the streets and even seduced her step-father, her mother forced her to enter the prestigious school, but she has no interest in it or following the proper etiquette.

She gets really excited when she hears dirty words, and when excited she says and wants to hear even more. Whenever Maron opens her mouth, majority of her sentences consist of words like "dick" and "pussy", but there seems to be a reason she's like that...

A girl that seeks sex just because she's bored. Such girl deserves some punishment! The [url=/c63055]protagonist[/url] takes up the task to teach her the difference between sex with and without love. She likes it when her ass becomes red from spanking.
